_about: Zonal Regulations rows that key on road width, transcribed from the plan's ZR PDF (text layer), with the PDF page and the page number printed on it. Bands follow ZR Table 4: upto_9 (<= 9 m), over_9_to_12, over_12_to_18, over_18_to_24, over_24. Road width per ZR 11.3 X: distance between the boundaries of the road incl. footways and drains; where it varies, the minimum over 200 m either side of the plot centre; service roads add to the main road.
